name: Ludányhalászi (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ludányhalászi (a green and blue shield with a white unicorn and a fish) above a yellow scroll inscribed LUDÁNYHALÁSZI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
